title: Vegan Roasted Dutch Peanuts
description: A hearty, comforting dish from the Netherlands roasted to perfection in peanut oil. Perfect for a hangover cure or a satisfying snack.
instructions: Spread the Dutch peanuts in a single layer on a parchment-lined Dutch oven.
Drizzle the peanut oil over the peanuts and sprinkle with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and cumin.
Toss the peanuts to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Roast the peanuts in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, shaking the Dutch oven halfway through.
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and sprinkle the maple syrup and water over the peanuts.
Return the Dutch oven to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 5 minutes, or until the peanuts are fragrant and lightly caramelized.
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and let the peanuts cool completely before serving.
Serve the roasted peanuts warm or at room temperature.
Store any leftover peanuts in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days.
